title: How to Build an ROI Calculator with AI (No Code Required)
summary: Build a custom ROI calculator that generates leads — input the customer's numbers, show them the savings, capture their email. Complete guide with Blink.
body_markdown: Test it with real customer data. Take 5–10 customer accounts, run their numbers through the calculator, and compare the output to what you know about their actual results. Adjust the calculation logic in Blink until the outputs match reality.
